query:
MATCH (res:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(cr:CR)
WHERE cr.clausesAffected IS NOT NULL AND trim(cr.clausesAffected) <> ''
MATCH (cr)-[:MODIFIES]->(hub:Spec)
WHERE hub.specRelease IS NULL
MATCH (cr)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(target:Release)
WITH DISTINCT res, cr, hub, target,
  [raw IN split(replace(cr.clausesAffected, ';', ','), ',')
   WHERE trim(raw) =~ '(?:[0-9]+\\.)+[A-Za-z]*[0-9]+\\s*-\\s*[0-9]+(?:\\s*\\([Nn][Ee][Ww]\\))?\\s*\\.?'] AS rawRanges
WITH res, cr, hub, target, rawRanges,
  [raw IN rawRanges | {
    lowerAddress: split(replace(trim(split(raw, '(')[0]), ' ', ''), '-')[0],
    upper: toInteger(replace(split(replace(trim(split(raw, '(')[0]), ' ', ''), '-')[1], '.', ''))
  }] AS rangeParts
WITH res, cr, hub, target, rawRanges,
  [part IN rangeParts | {
    lowerAddress: part.lowerAddress, upper: part.upper,
    digits: reduce(out = '', ch IN split(last(split(part.lowerAddress, '.')), '') |
      out + CASE WHEN ch =~ '[0-9]' THEN ch ELSE '' END)
  }] AS digitParts
WITH res, cr, hub, target,
  reduce(cleaned = cr.clausesAffected, raw IN rawRanges | replace(cleaned, raw, '')) AS literalField,
  reduce(ids = [], part IN digitParts |
    ids + [ordinal IN range(toInteger(part.digits), part.upper) |
      substring(part.lowerAddress, 0, size(part.lowerAddress) - size(part.digits)) + toString(ordinal)]) AS rangeIdentifiers
MATCH (sec:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(rk:Spec)-[:IN_RELEASE_OF]->(hub)
WHERE rk.specRelease = target.releaseName
  AND ((literalField CONTAINS sec.sectionNumber AND
        literalField =~ ('(?s).*(?<![A-Za-z0-9.])\\Q' + sec.sectionNumber + '\\E(?![A-Za-z0-9]|\\.[A-Za-z0-9]).*'))
       OR sec.sectionNumber IN rangeIdentifiers)
RETURN DISTINCT res.resolutionId AS resolutionId, cr.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber, sec.sectionId AS sectionId
ORDER BY resolutionId, tdocNumber, sectionId
